annotations.title: Compile a brief into what the agent accepts

description: Turn a plain-language request into the exact text and fields the agent’s own skill accepts, before asking for a price. Returns the skill it resolves to, every value that will be sent and where it came from, the exact payload, and one question per input that is still missing — each bound to the field it belongs to, so an answer is used for that field and never parsed back out of prose. Use it before get_quote or prepare_hire, and again after the user answers a question. Pokter fills nothing in on the user’s behalf: no wallet, chain, asset, amount or limit is ever invented, and a skill that publishes no input format is reported as exactly that rather than guessed at. Reads the agent’s published card; sends the brief to no one, moves nothing and signs nothing.

answers.description: Answers to the questions a previous call returned, keyed by the field key it asked for. Strings only.
